name: my-ui-kit-monorepo
description: Accessible, composable React UI kit + PWA reference app

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nisakhantalib/my-ui-kit && npm run dev -w demo
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nisakhantalib/my-ui-kit && npm run build -w demo
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run check:package
